what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Eritrea in Libya: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 8197 Eritrean asylum seekers in Libya, 6.9% of all asylum seekers from Eritrea.

why.text: UCDP records interstate armed conflicts between Eritrea and Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000 and in 2016, and between Djibouti and Eritrea in 2008.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Eritrea with EIJM - AS in 1999 and 2003.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2003 at 5 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 8382, at the end of 2023.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2014 to 2020 and 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Libya.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Libya only.
